verdict.rationale: Scribe's own API documents an enable_logging flag; setting it to false switches the request to zero retention mode, which is a per-request opt-out of request logging. The evidence does not show a broader opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking (for example account-level analytics or SDK telemetry), so this covers only part of the story. missing for 10: documented account-wide telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out, clarity on what logging or tracking still occurs in zero retention mode, SDK/client telemetry controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: When enable_logging is set to false zero retention mode will be used for the request.
